types.name: WCollisionMgr

fields.name: unk0

fields.name: collisionInstances

fields.name: numCollisionInstances

fields.name: collisionObjects

fields.name: instanceCacheMapAlloc
fields.comment: medium: MSVC std::map (12 bytes: allocator byte, head, size): ctor c5500 stores a byte to [this+0x14], allocates head node via 0x53580 (isnil at node+0x1d; 0x20-byte nodes freed in dtor c5460). PS2 +0x14 addr-taken -> FastFree. Name invented

fields.name: instanceCacheMapHead
fields.comment: medium: map head node (ctor [EDI+4]); dtor c5460 reads +0x18 and frees 0x20-byte nodes. Name invented

fields.name: instanceCacheMapSize
fields.comment: medium: map size, zeroed by ctor ([EDI+8]) and dtor. Name invented

fields.name: articleMapAlloc
fields.comment: medium: second MSVC std::map: ctor c5500 byte store, head from 0x94030 (isnil node+0x15; 0x18-byte nodes freed in dtor c5460); SetCollisionArticle c2ff0 does find (0x118f20) on this+0x20 and compares with end [this+0x24]. PS2 +0x20 addr-taken -> Fast

fields.name: articleMapHead
fields.comment: medium: map head node, compared as end() in SetCollisionArticle c2ff0; dtor reads +0x24. Name invented

fields.name: articleMapSize
fields.comment: medium: map size zeroed in ctor/dtor ([ESI+8] with ESI=this+0x20). Name invented

fields.name: unk2C
fields.comment: medium: ctor c5500 sets 0xf0 (240); PS2 ctor sets, FindFaceInTriStrip 2138b0 reads. Name invented

fields.name: unk30
fields.comment: medium: ctor c5500 byte store 0; PS2 ctor +0x30 w4 (4-byte bool). Name invented

types.comment: singleton: WCollisionMgr::Init (c55b0) does operator new(0x34) + ctor and stores the pointer in global 0x239a70 (fgCollisionMgr). No vptr; identical offsets on PS2 (GCC map is 12 bytes like the MSVC tree here).
